changes: Added FAST_VALIDATION_BEFORE_FULL_VALIDATION so normal E1 uses the smallest relevant validation before required full validation, while exact final-state certification remains mandatory.

Added SUPERSEDED_WORK_AUTO_CANCEL so obsolete heavy E1 work is cancelled/hygienized only when it cannot certify the current state, has no exclusive diagnostic evidence still needed, and cancellation is safe; E2/E3 are excluded.

Added FIRST_SUFFICIENT_SAFE_PASS_STOP so completed in-scope work stops before optional adjacent improvements, while any failed acceptance, regression, required validation, exact-state certification or hygiene condition forces continued correction and revalidation.
Preserved Project Leader 0.7.0 / Recovery Guardian 0.6.0 after regression-first correction of an unnecessary 0.7.1 version attempt; no Recovery Guardian implementation changed.
